name: Cetacea
source:
Cetacea is a visual novel made for SuNoFes22, that follows the story of a band of whales during the Whale Squid Wars.

[From [url=https://misdirectiongames.itch.io/cetacea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Cetacea》是为SuNoFes22创作的视觉小说，讲述一群鲸鱼在“鲸鱿战争”期间的故事。

[来源：[url=https://misdirectiongames.itch.io/cetacea]Itch.io[/url]]
